audit: Paper XI freeze original-grant and bounded font-notice audit
baseline_project_grant_status: No original project root license/grant or PDF sidecars existed. The author-confirmed October 20 open-license decision is expressed additively in this freeze.
grant_scope: MIT original software/machine-readable examples/data/evidence and code listings; CC BY4.0 original writing/figures/available editable writing. Original-project historical restrictions superseded. Third-party material retains its own terms.
font_origin_claim_boundary: Every current program independently parsed; installed candidate name and listed metadata compared. Subsets are not asserted to be exact original whole-font/source-build byte identities.

font_families_and_terms.terms: Supplied full URW notice with AGPL3 and its stated document/font exception; exact existing notice retained.
Primary face headers preserve original copyrights, GPL wording and stated document-embedding permission. No unstated GPL version inferred; generic GPL2 file is labeled reference.
Primary headers explicitly declare SIL OFL1.1, original copyrights and reserved names; full OFL1.1 supplied.
Current embedded header and installed primary PFB identify GUST terms; full Latin Modern terms and primary header supplied.
Existing distribution notice retained; exact Matplotlib DejaVu notice additionally supplies Tavmjong Bah/Arev permissions for the current matching metadata.
Exact installed STIX copyright/reserved-name/OFL1.1 notice included.
Full exact BaKoMa section from installed Matplotlib license supplied, including explicit free document embedding. Distinct from AMS CMSY10 Type1.

historical_scope: All historical PDF members and loose figure PDFs parsed for a bounded family-name inventory; no additional resource family found. Exact historical font-program/source/build origins are not certified. The Block02 source archive remains unrecovered.
published_path_resolution: Each notice published_path/path is relative to the release root. Full-evidence audit paths explicitly refer to the full ZIP only. Smaller reader ZIP carries entire LICENSES tree, LICENSE.md/status and all five PDF sidecars.
third_party_material_boundary: No blanket grant over external articles/books, quotations, source excerpts, references, compiler/dependency caches or fonts. Existing attributions and historical license bytes retained. No external cache or standalone font binary bundled.
required_freeze_actions: Copy the complete contents of audit_licenses/license_additions into the full release root; every path is new.
For reader ZIP, copy LICENSE.md, LICENSE_STATUS.json and the entire LICENSES tree; keep each current PDF .license sidecar beside its PDF.
Keep existing publication/source/traditional/fonts/LICENSE_URW.txt and LICENSE_DejaVu.txt unchanged at their original paths.
Copy audit metadata and scripts under the full freeze audit location. license_additions itself need not be nested there; it is a staging tree.
Retain the recorded grant scope, no whole-font byte-provenance claim, and bounded historical source/font limitations.

history.finding: P052-Italic installed candidate was not in the inherited candidate list; compact PostScript field syntax without whitespace was incompletely parsed.
history.resolution: Enumerated current installed URW/DejaVu candidates and corrected the bounded metadata parser to accept both standard whitespace forms; all 237 programs then have at least three exact listed metadata matches. This was a harness coverage issue, not a baseline defect.

history.reason: An incorrect parent directory was used for the installed Matplotlib distribution license. It raised FileNotFoundError before touching baseline files.
history.resolution: Corrected the source path and rebuilt the disposable additive staging tree; all complete grant/notice payload hashes and final paths pass.
